title: The room picture behind a building's window
oneLine: Room background image lifecycle: loading, ready (keeper drawn), failed (box removed); remounted per room id.

title: The Saloon's alliance part (alliance, war, rename wait, board)
oneLine: Alliance status, war, rename and war waits, and the alliance board, drawn from party_state.ally and allyBus.
topConcern: Board shows 'Asking...' forever when the worker refuses or rate-limits alliance_board; nothing re-asks until the board is reopened.

title: The Bank vault window (one move in flight)
oneLine: Vault view loading/open/closed/failed, a 4 s pending move keyed by opId, retry of a failed read.
topConcern: S._bank is never cleared on reconnect or character switch; a reopened window briefly draws the old vault.

title: The Cookhouse's cook and eat (client prediction)
oneLine: Cook/eat taps predict ingredients, dish, XP, level-up, quest flag and old-worker buff timers before the worker answers.
topConcern: Client counts ingredients by k.includes(type), worker by exact key: a predicted cook and level-up celebration the worker then takes back.

title: The Gambling Den's free daily spin
oneLine: Wheel phases idle/waiting/landing over the worker's stored pot (spin, double or nothing, collect, day rollover).
topConcern: After 8 s with no answer the panel says 'Nothing was spent', though a slow or lost answer may have spent or lost the pot.

title: The Enchanter's three gem sockets
oneLine: Weapon and shield gems asked with a 4 s pending gate; the amulet gem predicted locally with no gate.
topConcern: Double tap on an amulet gem burns two gems (second replaces first); its refusals are silent, so the prediction sticks on v2.

title: The General Store's order book (place and cancel over HTTP)
oneLine: Buy/sell/my-orders form, stash-index sell escrow, resting orders, cancel refunds, and an order-book cache.
topConcern: No in-flight guard or opId: a second Place Sell tap escrows the next weapon at the same stash index under the first one's kind.

title: The Feed & Seed shop and order board (farmBus)
oneLine: Farm view and order board from the worker; one pending request with 4 s / 12 s timeouts; midnight re-ask.
topConcern: A late answer to a timed-out request clears the newer pending request; farmBus.reset() is never called.

title: The trip onto your farm (three copies of one zone entry)
oneLine: Warp to farm_home: zone, map, position, per-zone arrays reset, farm art hold, return point remembered.
topConcern: Land Office copy calls startZoneAmbient('town') after the farm hold asked for farm music, so that trip plays BroTown's village track.

title: The legacy browser-only farm plots
oneLine: Plots planted and harvested on the phone by plantedAt+growTime stamps, only for workers without caps.farm.
topConcern: Client-only farm the echo undoes; kept as a rule-19 fallback that every live worker bypasses.

title: The Gambling Den's gold wager and weekly jackpot
oneLine: Chosen wager chip, worker-rolled bet with 2 s cooldown, 3 s result banner; jackpot pool and tickets.
topConcern: Legacy local roll and local pool remain for workers without caps.gamble / caps.jackpot.

title: The Gem Works' first tab: crack/combine and the one-gem cut fallback
oneLine: Shard crack and raw-gem combine asks with a 4 s pending gate; legacy one-gem cut when caps.shardcrack is off.
topConcern: Kill-switch fallback counts only the retired gem pouch, emptied into the bag at every join: 'No raw gems yet' over a full bag.

title: The Gladiator Arena window (queue, fight card, the real stake)
oneLine: Arena status polled from render, queue/fight/eliminated cards, and an append-only optimistic bet list.
topConcern: A refused stake still reads 'Bet placed'; bets keyed by round only, so an old tournament's bet hides later tournaments' forms.

title: The Blacksmith's bench (signature watch, salvage two-tap arm)
oneLine: One ask at a time; success inferred when a field signature changes within 3.5 s; smith work pose timer.
topConcern: An answer slower than 3.5 s is announced 'Could not forge' with the fail sound, and the later success is never said.

title: The Woodworker's bench (copied watch, Traps and Hardened receipt counters)
oneLine: Bow/staff craft and harden via P1-14's copied watch; trap and hardened-wood makes wait on receipt counters.
topConcern: Same 3.5 s false failure as the Blacksmith; a refused make_traps never bumps its counter, holding the buttons 3.5 s.

title: The Auction House shelf
oneLine: Shelf/yours tabs, category, one busy flag over buy, bid, accept and take-down; shelves re-read after answers.
topConcern: Browse answers applied in arrival order; a fast category switch can show an older category's rows briefly.

title: The Auction House chat and offers (storeChatBus)
oneLine: One listing's threads, offers and errors open at a time, plus per-listing unread counts.
topConcern: Closing the building window leaves storeChatBus.open true: reopening shows the old chat, and that listing's new lines raise no dot.

title: The Town Board (grid, page, nav heading, pins)
oneLine: Board grid vs a tile's page, the observed nav heading, and red/blue pin toggles stored per character.

title: Which building window is open (buildingPanel) and the halls that hand it on
oneLine: One nullable panel id opened at doors or keepers, closed by ✕, scrim, Esc, hall rows and farm trips.
topConcern: Panel buses and S fields outlive the window (store chat, market refresh key), read by the next opening as their own.
